essays.title: Public Cultural Institutions
habits: Uncountable nouns (staff, infrastructure, evidence, damage)
Adjective before noun (cultural vs culture)
No 'the' for general plural/uncountable ideas
Key word spelling (governments, institutions, excel)

essays.title: Protect the Environment
habits: a/an before adjective + singular countable noun
Countable vs uncountable (number of wildfires, widespread damage)
Word choice and collocation (pose challenges, endangered species)
Spelling and hyphens (wildfires, catastrophes, large-scale)
essays.note: Style notes (most of the species, discussed if) are not counted as errors. Overall is my estimate from one essay (mean 7.125, rounded to 7.0).

essays.title: Further Education in Britain (Task 1)
habits: Academic number notation (1,000,000 / one million vs informal 1000k)
Prepositions of time ('in 1970' for single points vs 'by 1970')
Past simple tense discipline for historical data (was/grew vs is/have grown)
Clause coordination & missing subject after 'There were'
a/an before adjective + singular noun ('a substantially larger number')
essays.note: Active homework assigned today (12 Nov 2026). Initial in-class diagnostic draft reviewed with Gareth; full Band 7.5 rewrite assigned for next lesson.

essays.title: Radio & TV Audiences in the UK 1992 (Task 1B)
habits: Past simple tense lock for 1992 data (was vs is)
Levels take 'to', not 'until' or 'bottom to' (fell to almost zero)
Drop 'a' before 'half of' & keep 'the UK population'
Time phrases & coordination (late at night, from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m., and then)
essays.note: Style notes are not counted as errors. Error-free ratio rose from 1/8 (Task 1A) to 3/8 (Task 1B), with a Band 7.5+ overview.

essays.title: Nuclear Energy vs Fossil Fuels (Outweigh)
habits: Topic-word spelling (emissions, guarantee, catastrophic)
Plurals, agreement & uncountables (infrastructure, earthquakes, One major disadvantage, Carbon emissions have)
Prepositions & missing linkers (need to address, recognised as, during events, as well as mitigating)
Comparison logic & verb forms (than that of many other..., has become, also has)
essays.note: Exact 250-word draft with strong C1 structures. Surface proofreading slips (4 spelling errors + plural/preposition/comparison slips) lowered error-free ratio to 2/13; 2-minute check restores Band 7.0+.

essays.title: Hydroelectric Power Station (Task 1C)
habits: Clear 150-word minimum (155-180w) by reporting every labelled stage (open/closed intake + drain to low-level reservoir)
Punctuation & capitalisation sweep (Overall, the... / five-stage / closing full stop)
Process prepositions (by the generator, via power lines, pumped by/through reversible turbines)
Drop 'below' in Intro and link repeated locations with ', where'
essays.note: Major accuracy breakthrough: 6/8 error-free sentences, zero spelling slips, and strong present simple active/passive control. Adding the two missed diagram details lifts word count past 150 and TA to 7.5.

essays.title: Grange Park Maps 1920 vs Today (Final-Week Timed Task 1)
habits: Copy map labels verbatim (amphitheatre, water plants, car park)
Opener subject check (Despite having the exact same size, the park...)
Singular/plural agreement & map precision (Only the rose garden on the north-west side was kept)
First-mention article (an underground car park) & British spelling consistency (centre)
essays.note: First timed Task 1 well past 150 words (219 words across 4 clean paragraphs), reporting every major redevelopment accurately. Copying labels off the plan lifts LR and GRA straight into 7.0-7.5.

essays.title: Self-Employment: Reasons & Disadvantages (Final-Week Timed Task 2)
habits: Clear 250-word floor by adding one consequence sentence after each For example (aim 265-285 words, 4 paragraphs)
Verb patterns & small words (provides them with, decide which, minimises exposure, benefits of economies of scale)
Present simple lock for general truths (the financial volatility it introduces)
Keep British -ise consistent (prioritise, organisations) and check bureaucratic spelling
essays.note: Major final-week accuracy jump: error-free sentences doubled to 6/13, intro comma splice defeated (While some..., others...), and genuine spelling slips down to 1 (beurocratic). Adding one follow-up sentence per example lifts TR past 7.0.
